CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  June 22, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Absent: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 719 Irving Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1) the east
entry door wall of the front unit and the south wall outside the closet of the rear unit shall be
finished in stucco and; 2) MWELO landscape documents shall be provided as required at time of
plan check.

The applicants Doug Lau and Craig Statton was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was
given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

Craig Statton spoke as the CEO of Atherton Baptist Homes. He spoke in support fo the project and
gave a brief background of the site and this phase of work. Atherton has been a part of Alhambra
for 100 years and caring for seniors.

The architect, Doug Lau understood the conditions generally and questioned the locations of the
staff concerns. He stated that he does not illustrate appropriate trim and baseboard.

Mr. Abe clarified the staff concern over the lack of dimensionality because the siding and stucco
create a knife edge condition. The condition occurs on both front and back units.

Hernandez stated that she was accepting of the balance of stucco and siding but that the materials
need to be terminated with the appropriate trim. She clarified that the condition in question along
the driveway side includes siding.

  1
 Abe concurred and it is actually the front wall immediately behind the front patio facing the street
is the stucco wall in question. This wall and the entry door wall is the intersection with the knife
edge.

Hernandez stated the trim needs to be finished correctly.

The applicant stated that trim would be provided and requested conditional approval.

Tsai posed several questions regarding ramp accessibility, the enclosure of the patios and the
material condition of the patio enclosure wall. He also mentioned the issue brought up during staff
comments.

Lau stated that the project was designed for senior living and issues of accessibility. The patio was
within the mean setback. The street is vacated and Atherton property. He described the siding and
stucco conditions.

Tsai questioned if the applicant performed a survey and questioned the topography of the property.
The rationale for this comment stemmed from the appearance of the ramp and street frontage.

The applicant gave a brief description of the property slope and the adjacent properties. He also
stated that the ramp shown is fully ADA compliant.

Chiu concurred with Tsai’s comments with regard to the ramp and the impression of the raised
areas to the street. Landscape can mitigate this condition and should be included in the conditions
of approval. She also questioned the height of the patio wall. Chiu stated that typically walls at the
front of the house are discouraged as it isolates the house from the sidewalk/community.

The applicant stated that it was 6’ from the inside of the patio. Lau stated that the patio was
originally for privacy. Landscape will be provided to address the ramp and the patio wall.

Abe stated that the height of the patio enclosure was allowed because of the private ownership of
the Atherton Development. If this was a public condition the wall would be limited to 3’ high. But
because the street is vacated and on Atherton property this can be addressed through a condition.

The applicant asked for Board consensus on the height of the patio wall. He also mentioned that a
guardrail height of 42” would be preferred for safety reasons.

Chiu suggested the use of different materials and openings to help mitigate the visual perception
of the height of the wall. Tsai and Hernandez concurred with that comment.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approved the application with the following conditions: 1. The
  front patio wall shall not exceed 42” high; 2. The applicant shall work with staff on a
  combination of materials and landscape to mitigate the massing at the front elevation; 3.
  The applicant shall work with staff work regarding the termination and use of siding and
  stucco; 4. MWELO landscape documents shall be provided as required at the time of plan

  2
   check; and 5. Any revised or supplemental information shall be reviewed and approved by
  DRB staff prior to Planning commission meeting. Second was by Stanley Tsai
  •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 2028 South Chapel

Recommended Action: approval as submitted.

The applicant Kamen Lai was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

The applicant stated that he would accept any conditions and was appreciative of the staff review.

Tsai stated that he was accepting of the project design.

Hernandez also stated her support of the design.

Chiu asked for a clarification from the applicant. The clerestory windows at the second floor above
the porch show a sill detail is shown as different from the other windows. The applicant stated that
the clerestory windows are recessed with a chamfered sill. As such it will provide a subtle
distinction for these windows. Chiu recognized this as a positive feature.

MOTION:
 •  Stanley Tsai moved to approved the application as submitted with the condition that
  MWELO landscape documents shall be provided as required at time of plan check.
 •  Second was by Nora Hernandez
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
• There were no public comments or oral communications.

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:10
 •  Seconded by Stanley Tsai.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai

  3
 Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.
